items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: But then you introduced me to Cannonball Adderley, and that changed my whole world around.

ctx.x: Well it’s really your fault because — um not your fault but — like you know I was, basically as you know, before I was a classical musician, like [plays]. You know, like the Glazunov Concerto. And I don’t think there’s anything wrong with that. But then you introduced me to Cannonball Adderley, and that changed my whole world around. It really did.
Well it changed mine too. You know I think there was something about him that is still sort of indescribable. But it’s something to aspire to.
